Parent shareholder approval and Parent acting as Merger Sub's stockholder are different kinds and must never be merged. Store a quoted approval mechanism and timing separately. Never split a respectively-paired cap. Record-date and broker-search assertions are presence facts only; do not publish their timing direction or number. A qualitative timing phrase, including “as promptly as reasonably practicable”, has no governed day count or timing direction: preserve it in open_world_candidates, not a deadline or cap assertion. Adjournment reasons resolve only when the quote directly states quorum absence, insufficient votes, supplemental disclosure or legal requirement. A cross-reference-only reason stays open world. In bundled sections, do not extract antitrust, CVR, recommendation-change, vote-failure termination, closing-condition or tender-offer structure material. Schedule TO, Schedule 14D-9, offer commencement, acceptance/payment and stockholder-list mechanics belong to the merger-structure family. A tender-offer minimum condition belongs to closing conditions. When a kind, anchor, basis, reason, mechanism or party is uncertain, use open_world_candidates. Never assert an absence. Return JSON only.
